This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], this [[Human/Legends|Human]] received [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], ascending to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Constructing a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] imbued with blue [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] at its core, this Master was proficient in it use during [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]].<ref name="SWBII" />

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], this man took up the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Surviving three years of war, he was stationed at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] when the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] betrayed the Order and issued [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the Grand Army, ordering them to kill their Jedi leaders. As the forces of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] stormed the Temple as part of [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], this man joined [[Unidentified Jedi Master 2|other]] [[Unidentified Jedi Master 3|masters]] and led a final charge against [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on the [[Jedi Temple veranda|Temple Veranda]]. While fighting valiantly against the clones under the command of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], this Master and his companions were slain during the fighting and the Temple fell into the hands of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="SWBII" />

==Powers and abilities==
This Jedi Master used a blue [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]]. He was a talented swordsman as he was one of the last Jedi standing during the attack on the Temple.<ref name="SWBII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The three Jedi Masters are killed by the player in ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', but the means of their execution is not standardized. They can be killed either as Vader or a clone trooper at the whim of the player.
